predictions.text: I predict that the specific details and cultural influences of Halloween will be finalized for the celebration, emphasizing its Christian origins and the influence of Celtic harvest festivals, particularly Samhain.

I predict that thousands of students and teachers will march through Athens, Thessaloniki, and Patras in Greece to protest against the rising cost of living, calling for affordable student housing and more state investment in education.
I predict that the Israeli military conducts additional raids and arrests in the West Bank cities previously targeted, including the city of Hebron.
I predict that the investigations into the 2026 Karak church shooting will lead to the questioning of two suspects in Jordan by the end of Sunday, 1 November 2026.
I predict that the number of arrests in Italian unrest (crime) will exceed 71 by the end of Sunday, 1 November 2026, with clashes reported in at least two cities across Italy.
I predict that the total number of people evacuated during Typhoon Champi will be around 2,639.

I predict that the suspect will be charged with additional counts of murder and attempted murder in the 2026 Trappes and La Verrière shootings, with the charges covering the deaths of two more individuals and injuries to three others.
I predict that Australia and at least one other country join in imposing sanctions against North Korea.

I predict that an important politician from Greece will announce that the largest social media platforms, including those with over 1 billion monthly active users, will be required to comply with the new Greek law by the end of Sunday, 1 November 2026.
I predict that the 2026 World Artistic Gymnastics Championships will see the Russian team win the team finals in both the men's and women's categories.
